protocol.oracle: Development only; manually selected original source spans, full small documents. Goldens and answer text never enter product input. Original generator/reviewer, notes and rule drafts remain enabled.
protocol.holdout: Do not examine answers or judge results until all code is frozen and development selection.json is written. No tuning after holdout. Same author/corpus; selection holdout, not proof of hidden PSB generalization.
protocol.selection: Choose whole candidate on development only: require no runtime errors, full judge coverage, no manually confirmed factual regressions versus v239, and pairwise score>50. Highest score; exact tie prefers context-only then baseline. If neither qualifies, retain v239. Both alternatives still reported on holdout without further selection.
protocol.review_diagnostic: Capture original initial draft and final answer; judge changed drafts on development only, with final as team and initial as baseline.
protocol.judge: Unchanged frozen team-relative two-order DeepSeek judge and PSB arithmetic. New baseline is fresh v239; do not compare these scores to old20 scores.
protocol.reuse: Only identical complete model requests, embeddings and Qwen requests may reuse results. All calls and cache hits recorded. No unfavorable-judge rerolls.

pre_run_revision.scope: Whitespace only in question/golden text; no fact changes. Applied before any model call or product experiment.
